extensionDescription.message: Polishes the GitHub you use every day, starting with pull requests. Not affiliated with GitHub, Inc.

feature_imageModal.message: Opens images from issues, PRs, comments and READMEs in a zoomable modal instead of a new tab.

feature_diffStats.message: Shows lines added and removed for each PR in the pull request lists, of a repository and your own on github.com/pulls.

feature_reviewStatus.message: Shows where each PR stands for you in the pull request lists, of a repository and your own on github.com/pulls: review requested, re-review, changes requested, or approved with commits pushed since.

feature_idlePrs.message: Flags PRs with no recent activity in the pull request lists, of a repository and your own on github.com/pulls.

feature_quickComments.message: Buttons above the comment box that post a predefined comment in one click. Shift-click inserts it instead.

feature_quickApprovals.message: A button next to the review button that approves the pull request with one of your predefined messages.

feature_reviewerLoad.message: Shows how many reviews each person already has pending in the reviewers picker of a PR.

feature_mergeEmail.message: Picks the commit email for each owner when you merge a pull request.

feature_unresolvedComments.message: Shows how many review conversations are still unresolved on each open PR in the pull request lists, of a repository and your own on github.com/pulls.

feature_stackActions.message: Marks a whole stack of pull requests ready for review, and requests the reviewers you add on one PR of a stack on the others too.

about_description.message: I build Polished GitHub on my own time, for the GitHub I use all day at work. It's free, open source and collects nothing. If it saves you time, you can help me keep it going.

mergeEmail_suggestionsHelp.message: Suggestions come from the merge boxes you open. To list all your emails at once, give the token read access to Email addresses (fine-grained) or the user:email scope (classic).
